nodes.label: FluidWake.injectStroke
nodes.rationale: Six CSS pixels at the tip; the stroke stretches downstream through advection.

nodes.label: FluidWake.step
nodes.rationale: Under reduced motion the velocity field is cleared and only dye fades; otherwise advection, vorticity, pressure projection and dye transport advance the field.

nodes.label: Dye clearing mask in fog
nodes.rationale: The simulation does not draw smoke; it encodes where smoke should be erased so pointer movement carves a wake through the atmosphere.

nodes.label: camera-reference-cutout.webp asset

nodes.label: InteractiveSmoke paint
nodes.rationale: Composites the live shader or cached sprites with screen blending, then punches out the fluid dye mask using destination-out.

nodes.label: InteractiveSmoke animation tick
nodes.rationale: Runs at 60 fps while a wake is active and 30 fps otherwise, and stops entirely once reduced motion and dispersal have settled.

nodes.label: InteractiveSmoke pointer handler
nodes.rationale: Uses coalesced events and ignores tiny moves; entering or resting the cursor never stamps a circular hole.

nodes.label: InteractiveSmoke wheel handler
nodes.rationale: Wheel input preserves broad dispersal without adding a local disk.

nodes.label: InteractiveSmoke resize
nodes.rationale: Caps canvas resolution at 1000 px and fluid grid at 240 cells to bound work on large screens.

nodes.label: Procedural-airflow vs canvas-airflow renderer selection
nodes.rationale: The component probes for a usable WebGL context and exposes the choice through data-smoke-renderer, falling back to animated canvas sprites when shaders are unavailable.

nodes.label: Animated Canvas 2D sprite fallback
nodes.rationale: Six cached sprites are offset and phased to imitate drifting clouds on devices without a usable shader context.

nodes.label: LiveSmokeRenderer.create
nodes.rationale: Returns null instead of throwing so callers can select the canvas fallback.

nodes.label: LiveSmokeRenderer constructor
nodes.rationale: Requests a low-power WebGL context and fails fast on compilation or link errors.

nodes.label: LiveSmokeRenderer.render
nodes.rationale: Reports failure on context loss so the caller can switch to the canvas fallback.

nodes.label: Domain-warped FBM smoke shader
nodes.rationale: Nested fbm fields fold wisps into ribbons; crosswind, lift, vertical falloff and lateral falloff shape the haze without any image asset.

nodes.label: Demand-driven 3D rendering
nodes.rationale: frameloop='demand' avoids a permanent render loop; pointer input and damping explicitly invalidate frames, and reduced motion resets the rig to a neutral pose.

nodes.label: Avaris Transparent Cinema Camera Cutout
nodes.rationale: Hero foreground extracted from the approved Avaris reference: a professional black cinema camera rig shown at three-quarter view with a large square matte box, raised top flap, lens, upper monitor, top handle, rails/follow-focus hardware, fluid head and tripod legs cropped at the bottom edge. Composition is a roughly square 1254x1254 canvas, tightly framed with a small transparent margin; the monitor top and matte-box tips are retained while the tripod legs run off the lower edge. Background treatment is true alpha transparency: transparent corners, no floor, haze, text, logo, checkerboard or cast shadow, with about half the canvas empty. Lighting is the original restrained dark cinematic look with black materials and subtle cool/red accents, not relit or redesigned. Design role: a compositable, replaceable hero layer placed over the separate studio plate and swappable for the 3D GLB scene later.

nodes.label: Professional Cinema Camera Rig Subject
nodes.rationale: The depicted subject is a black professional cinema camera body on rails with follow-focus hardware, presented at a three-quarter view facing front-left so the lens and matte box read clearly. nodes.label: Avaris brand favicon SVG
nodes.rationale: Single self-contained SVG linked as the site icon in index.html and services/index.html; a minimal burgundy quadrilateral on a small square canvas.

nodes.label: Slanted parallelogram glyph
nodes.rationale: Path M26 8h29L36 56H7z traces a left-leaning quadrilateral with parallel top and bottom edges (points 26,8 / 55,8 / 36,56 / 7,56), reading as an italic panel or tilted frame.

nodes.label: Burgundy crimson fill
nodes.rationale: The glyph is filled with the single solid color #8d223f, a deep burgundy crimson that sits between the site's accepted burgundy accents #7B1D36 and #9B2946 described in THEME.md.

nodes.label: 64 by 64 scalable canvas
nodes.rationale: viewBox="0 0 64 64" defines a square vector coordinate space, allowing the mark to scale cleanly to browser-tab and device icon sizes.

nodes.label: Favicon as compact brand mark
nodes.rationale: The favicon distills the Avaris cinematic identity into one flat geometric mark: restrained burgundy, no text, and a slanted panel that echoes the site's minimal dark-studio visual direction.

nodes.label: Possible cinematic motion reading
nodes.rationale: The forward lean of the quadrilateral could be intended to suggest motion, an italic letterform, or a tilted film frame; the source SVG carries no explicit statement of intent, so this reading is uncertain.
